text:
Maya: Thinking about an 'operator snooze' for auto-fallback alerts — when we auto-degrade a route we get a flood of short-lived fallbacks in the operator inbox. Can we add a per-route / per-rollout snooze (5–15m) so operators aren't overwhelmed during traffic spikes?

Ravi: Love the idea for noise reduction. Two product constraints: 1) snooze must not remove auditability — we still need a complete event trail. 2) operators must be able to opt-out per-route.

Jon: Implementation sketch: add a `snooze_window` field on the fallback policy and a `snoozed_by` enum (system/operator). Example:```yaml
policy:
  auto_fallback:
    enabled: true
    snooze_minutes: 10
    snoozed_by: system
    record_events: true
```
This keeps telemetry but suppresses individual inbox notifications. We can emit periodic summaries.

Lina: Be careful — snoozing can obscure sustained failures. We should gate snooze by error-rate delta. If error-rate stays > baseline + X% for >Y minutes, snooze auto-cancels and escalates. Also watch quotas/backpressure; a snooze that hides retries could mean we hit capacity silently.

Maya: UI note: show a small "SNOOZED" pill next to the route in Rollouts > Active, with hover showing reason and snooze expiry. Add an obvious "Unsnooze" button and link to the audit timeline.

ops-bot: [audit] event recorded: fallback.snooze_applied route=products-search duration_mins=10 by=system ts=1777733333

Jon: We should also add summarized telemetry every N minutes: `degrade_summary{route,window_start,window_end,total_fallbacks,errors_suppressed}`. That lets oncall review without message spam.

Ravi: Add three telemetry keys for the rollout API: `fallback_snoozed_by`, `fallback_snooze_reason`, `snooze_window_sec`. Product will use them to populate the Audit and Rollout Timeline.

Lina: For alerts, rather than per-fallback notifications, send a single alert if suppressed_error_count > threshold OR if the suppressed error trend is increasing. Keep the original event ids in the summary so forensic playback still works.

Maya: Sounds like consensus. Next steps: Jon to prototype the policy field + summary telemetry, Lina to propose the exact threshold numbers (baseline+X%, time window Y), Ravi to add the UI mockups for the snooze pill and unsnooze flow. I'll create the tickets. @Jon can you pick up a small PR? :thumbsup:

Jon: Yep, I'll carve out a spike tomorrow. Will put a tiny schema PR up and wire the `record_events:true` path so audit logs stay intact.

Maya: Great — thanks everyone.
